content.text:
Text-message notices are now capped at 160 characters. A longer body keeps its first 157 characters and ends in `...`. The full suite passes (63 tests).

The change is in `lib/notices/compose.js`. Every notice goes through `composeNotice`, including hold-ready, due-soon and overdue. One change therefore covers all of them. Email notices are untouched.

Two details:
- **Counting:** the cut counts characters, not UTF-16 units, so an emoji or other non-BMP character in a title is never split in half. That matches "characters" in your spec. If the provider counts by encoded segment, the limit would need revisiting.
- **What gets trimmed:** only the end of the body is trimmed. For a long title on a hold, that can cut off the pickup branch and deadline rather than just the title. Say if you'd rather truncate the title and keep the rest of the message.

I added three tests to `test/notices.test.js`:
- A long text message comes out at exactly 160 characters and ends in `...`.
- A text message of exactly 160 characters is left alone.
- A long email is not cut.

I haven't committed anything.
